Cabinet approves Rs 12,500 crore PM-Surya Ghar extension and Polavaram funding

Posted On: 02 OCT 2026 3:15PM by PIB Delhi

The Union Cabinet chaired by the Prime Minister on Thursday approved the extension of PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana till March 2028 with an outlay of Rs. 12,500 crore.

The Cabinet also approved release of Rs. 2,800 crore to the Polavaram Irrigation Project in Andhra Pradesh, a national project under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014.

Under the scheme, 1 crore households will get rooftop solar panels and up to 300 units of free electricity every month.
